position.en: Associate Professor · Head of the Master of Information Technology program, Fasilkom UI

id: Dr. Panca Hadi Putra adalah associate professor di Fakultas Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia. Minat risetnya mencakup sistem informasi, user experience, bisnis digital, dan informatika hukum. Untuk riset informatika hukum, ia memimpin Lexin, tempat peneliti multidisiplin mengembangkan platform teknologi hukum.

Di UI ia mengajar di program Magister Teknologi Informasi Fasilkom dan Magister Manajemen FEB, antara lain Analisis dan Perancangan Sistem, Metodologi Penelitian, Manajemen Strategis Sistem Informasi, Technology Entrepreneurship, dan Business Analytics. Di luar UI ia mengajar mata kuliah hukum terkait TI di program Magister Kenotariatan.

Sebelum berkarier di dunia akademik, ia aktif berwirausaha dan menjadi konsultan bagi berbagai merek, mulai dari perusahaan Fortune 500 seperti PT Sony Indonesia dan PT Tupperware Indonesia, pemimpin kategori seperti PT Kalbe Nutritionals, PT Darya Varia Tbk., dan Del Monte Indonesia, hingga organisasi nirlaba seperti British Council dan Yayasan Sayap Ibu.
en: Dr. Panca Hadi Putra is an associate professor at the Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Indonesia. His research interests are information systems, user experience, digital business and legal informatics. For legal informatics, he leads Lexin, where multidisciplinary researchers develop legal technology platforms.

At UI he teaches in the Master of Information Technology program at Fasilkom and the Master of Management program at the Faculty of Economics and Business, including Systems Analysis and Design, Research Methodology, Strategic Information Systems Management, Technology Entrepreneurship and Business Analytics. Outside UI, he teaches IT-related law courses in Master of Notarial Law programs.

Before academia, he was an entrepreneur and consultant for brands ranging from Fortune 500 companies such as PT Sony Indonesia and PT Tupperware Indonesia, category leaders such as PT Kalbe Nutritionals, PT Darya Varia Tbk. and Del Monte Indonesia, to non-profits such as the British Council and the Sayap Ibu Foundation.

id: Prof. Indra Budi adalah dosen ilmu komputer dan sistem informasi di Fakultas Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia, dan kini menjabat Kepala Program Studi Magister dan Doktor Ilmu Komputer. Risetnya mencakup ekstraksi informasi, text dan data mining, analisis sentimen, serta analisis jejaring sosial. Di Lexin, ia berperan sebagai penasihat dan research scientist.
en: Prof. Indra Budi is a lecturer in computer science and information systems at the Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Indonesia, and heads the Master and Doctoral programs in Computer Science. His research covers information extraction, text and data mining, sentiment analysis and social network analysis. At Lexin, he serves as advisor and research scientist.

id: Alfan Farizki Wicaksono adalah dosen di Fakultas Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia. Ia meraih Ph.D. dari University of Melbourne, M.Sc. dari Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, dan S.T. dari Institut Teknologi Bandung. Risetnya berada di persimpangan information retrieval, representation learning, dan text mining, bidang yang penting untuk alat riset hukum.
en: Alfan Farizki Wicaksono is a lecturer at the Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Indonesia. He holds a Ph.D. from the University of Melbourne, an M.Sc. from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology and an S.T. from Institut Teknologi Bandung. His research sits at the intersection of information retrieval, representation learning and text mining, all central to legal research tools.

id: Rahmad Mahendra adalah dosen dan peneliti di Fakultas Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia. Ia menempuh studi doktoral di RMIT University, meraih M.Sc. Informatika dari Free University of Bozen-Bolzano, dan S.Kom. dari Universitas Indonesia. Risetnya mencakup NLP, text mining, ekstraksi informasi, sistem tanya jawab, dan analitik media sosial, serta aktif dalam inisiatif sumber daya NLP Indonesia.
en: Rahmad Mahendra is a lecturer and researcher at the Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Indonesia. He pursued doctoral studies at RMIT University, holds an M.Sc. in Informatics from the Free University of Bozen-Bolzano and an S.Kom. from Universitas Indonesia. His research spans NLP, text mining, information extraction, question answering and social media analytics, and he is active in Indonesian NLP resource initiatives.

Risetnya berfokus pada representasi pengetahuan dan penalaran, logika komputasional, serta pemodelan moralitas dengan logic programming.
en: Ari Saptawijaya is a lecturer and computer science researcher at the Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Indonesia, and serves as Vice Dean for Education, Research and Student Affairs. His research focuses on knowledge representation and reasoning, computational logic and modelling morality with logic programming.
